sourceDate.text: 天祿五年春正月癸亥朔

place.en: Xian Mausoleum, western hills of Xian Prefecture

filial, brotherly, lenient, and kind; possessed a ruler's measure

label.en: chief clerk of tribal and Han forces

units.zh: 世宗孝和莊憲皇帝，諱阮，小字兀欲。
units.en: Emperor Shizong, posthumously Xiaohé Zhuangxian, bore the personal name Ruan and the childhood name Wuyu.
units.literal: Emperor Shizong, posthumously Xiaohé Zhuangxian, personal name Ruan, childhood name Wuyu.

units.zh: 讓國皇帝長子，母柔貞皇后蕭氏。
units.en: He was the eldest son of the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm, and his mother was Empress Rouzhen of the Xiao clan.
units.literal: He was the eldest son of the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm; his mother was Empress Rouzhen, née Xiao.

units.zh: 帝儀觀豐偉，內寬外嚴，善騎射，樂施予，人望歸之。
units.en: He was imposing in bearing, lenient at heart yet stern in demeanor, skilled at horsemanship and archery, generous by nature, and the people looked to him with hope.
units.literal: The emperor was imposing in bearing, lenient within and stern without, skilled at horsemanship and archery, delighted in giving, and the people's hopes turned to him.

units.zh: 太宗愛之如子。
units.en: Emperor Taizong loved him as his own son.
units.literal: Emperor Taizong loved him as a son.

units.zh: 會同九年，從伐晉。
units.en: In the ninth year of Huitong he took part in the campaign against Jin.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Huitong he followed the campaign against Jin.

units.zh: 大同元年春二月，封永康王。
units.en: In the second month of spring in the first year of Datong he was enfeoffed as Prince Yongkang.
units.literal: In the second month of spring in the first year of Datong he was enfeoffed as Prince Yongkang.

units.zh: 夏四月丁丑，太宗崩於欒城。
units.en: In the fourth month that summer, on dingchou day, Emperor Taizong died at Luancheng.
units.literal: That summer, on dingchou day of the fourth month, Emperor Taizong died at Luancheng.

units.zh: 戊寅，梓宮次鎮陽，即皇帝位於柩前。
units.en: On wuyin day the imperial coffin paused at Zhenyang, and he took the throne before the bier.
units.literal: On wuyin day the coffin halted at Zhenyang, and he took the throne before the bier.

units.zh: 甲申，次定州，命天德、朔古、解裏等護梓宮先赴上京。
units.en: On jiashen day he stopped at Ding Prefecture and ordered Tiande, Shuogu, Jieli, and others to escort the coffin on to the Supreme Capital first.
units.literal: On jiashen day he halted at Ding Prefecture and ordered Tiande, Shuogu, Jieli, and others to escort the coffin ahead to the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 太后聞帝即位，遣太弟李胡率兵拒之。
units.en: Learning that the Emperor had succeeded, the Empress Dowager sent Li Hu, the Imperial Younger Brother, with an army to oppose him.
units.literal: When the Empress Dowager heard the Emperor had succeeded, she sent Li Hu, the Imperial Younger Brother, with troops to resist him.

units.zh: 六月甲寅朔，次南京，五院夷離堇安端、詳穩劉哥遣人馳報，請為前鋒；
units.en: On the jiayin new moon of the sixth month he reached the Southern Capital; Five Courts yilijin Anduan and xiangwen Liu Ge sent riders in haste to offer themselves as vanguard.
units.literal: On the jiayin new moon of the sixth month he halted at the Southern Capital; Five Courts yilijin Anduan and xiangwen Liu Ge sent swift messengers asking to serve as vanguard.

units.zh: 至泰德泉，遇李胡軍，戰敗之。
units.en: At Taide Spring he met Li Hu's army and routed it.
units.literal: Reaching Taide Spring, he met Li Hu's army and defeated it.

units.zh: 上遣郎君勤德等詣兩軍諭解。
units.en: The Emperor sent langjun Qinde and others to both camps to urge a settlement.
units.literal: The Emperor sent langjun Qinde and others to both armies to counsel reconciliation.

units.zh: 秋閏七月，次潢河，太后、李胡整兵拒於橫渡，相持數日。
units.en: In the intercalary seventh autumn month he halted at the Huang River; the Empress Dowager and Li Hu arrayed troops to resist at Hengdu Ford, and the two sides faced off for several days.
units.literal: In the intercalary month of autumn, the seventh month, he halted at the Huang River; the Empress Dowager and Li Hu arrayed troops to resist at Hengdu Ford, and they faced off for several days.

units.zh: 用屋質之謀，各罷兵趨上京。
units.en: Following Wuzhi's counsel, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.
units.literal: Following Wuzhi's plan, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 既而聞太后、李胡復有異謀，遷於祖州。
units.en: Before long, hearing that the Empress Dowager and Li Hu were plotting again, he had them moved to Zu Prefecture.
units.literal: Soon after, hearing the Empress Dowager and Li Hu were plotting again, he had them moved to Zu Prefecture.

units.zh: 誅司徒劃設及楚補裏。
units.en: He executed Minister over the Masses Huashe and Chubuli.
units.literal: Minister over the Masses Huashe and Chubuli were put to death.

units.zh: 八月壬午朔，尊母蕭氏為皇太后，以太后族剌只撒古魯為國舅帳，立詳穩以總焉。
units.en: On the renwu new moon of the eighth month he honored his mother, Lady Xiao, as Empress Dowager, made the empress dowager's kinsman Laji Saguolu head of the imperial maternal-uncle account, and set a xiangwen over it.
units.literal: On the renwu new moon of the eighth month he honored his mother Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager, made the empress dowager's clansman Laji Saguolu head of the imperial maternal-uncle account, and appointed a xiangwen to oversee it.

units.zh: 以崇德宮戶分賜翼戴功臣，及北院大王窪、南院大王吼各五十，安摶、楚補各百。
units.en: Households from the Palace of Honored Virtue were divided and bestowed on those who had raised him to the throne; Northern Chancellor Wa and Southern Chancellor Hou each received fifty, and Anpo and Chubu each a hundred.
units.literal: Households from the Palace of Honored Virtue were divided and bestowed on meritorious supporters; Northern Chancellor Wa and Southern Chancellor Hou each received fifty; Anpo and Chubu each a hundred.

units.zh: 的魯、鐵剌子孫先以非罪籍沒者歸之。
units.en: Descendants of Dilu and Tiela, earlier registered and confiscated though guilty of no crime, were restored to them.
units.literal: Descendants of Dilu and Tiela, earlier registered and confiscated without crime, were restored to them.

units.zh: 癸未，始置北院樞密使，以安摶為之。
units.en: On guiwei day the Northern Palace Commissioner was established for the first time, with Anpo appointed to the post.
units.literal: On guiwei day the Northern Palace Commissioner was first established, with Anpo appointed to it.

units.zh: 九月壬子朔，葬嗣聖皇帝於懷陵。
units.en: On the renzi new moon of the ninth month the Succeeding Sage Emperor was interred at Huai Mausoleum.
units.literal: On the renzi new moon of the ninth month the Succeeding Sage Emperor was buried at Huai Mausoleum.

units.zh: 丁卯，行柴冊禮，群臣上尊號曰天授皇帝。
units.en: On dingmao day the firewood-and-script rites were performed, and the assembled ministers offered the honorific title Emperor Who Received Heaven's Mandate.
units.literal: On dingmao day the firewood-and-script rites were performed; the assembled ministers offered the honorific title Emperor Who Received Heaven's Mandate.

units.zh: 大赦，改大同元年為天祿元年。
units.en: He proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the first year of Datong to the first year of Tianlu.
units.literal: A general amnesty was granted, and the first year of Datong was changed to the first year of Tianlu.

units.zh: 追謚皇考曰讓國皇帝。
units.en: He gave his late father the posthumous title Emperor Who Yielded the Realm.
units.literal: His deceased father was posthumously titled Emperor Who Yielded the Realm.

units.zh: 以安端主東丹國，封明王，察割為泰寧王，劉哥為惕隱，高勛為南院樞密使。
units.en: Anduan was set to rule the Dongdan state and enfeoffed as Prince of Ming; Chage was made Prince of Taining; Liu Ge was made tiyin; and Gao Xun was made Southern Palace Commissioner.
units.literal: Anduan was made to rule the Dongdan state and enfeoffed as Prince of Ming; Chage as Prince of Taining; Liu Ge as tiyin; Gao Xun as Southern Palace Commissioner.

units.zh: 二年春正月，天德、蕭翰、劉哥、盆都等謀反。
units.en: In the spring of the second year, first month, Tiande, Xiao Han, Liu Ge, Pendu, and others plotted rebellion.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, Tiande, Xiao Han, Liu Ge, Pendu, and others plotted rebellion.

units.zh: 誅天德，杖蕭翰，遷劉哥於邊，罰盆都使轄戛斯國。
units.en: Tiande was executed, Xiao Han was flogged, Liu Ge was transferred to the frontier, and Pendu was punished by being sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.
units.literal: Tiande was executed, Xiao Han was beaten with the staff, Liu Ge was transferred to the frontier, and Pendu was punished by being sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.

units.zh: 漢主劉知遠殂，子承祐立。
units.en: Han ruler Liu Zhiyuan died, and his son Chengyou succeeded him.
units.literal: Han ruler Liu Zhiyuan died, and his son Chengyou succeeded.

units.zh: 夏四月庚辰朔，南唐遣李朗、王祚來慰且賀，兼奉蠟丸書，議攻漢。
units.en: On the gengchen new moon of the fourth summer month Southern Tang sent Li Lang and Wang Zuo with condolences and congratulations, also presenting a wax-ball dispatch to discuss an attack on Han.
units.literal: On the gengchen new moon of the fourth summer month Southern Tang sent Li Lang and Wang Zuo to offer condolences and congratulations, also presenting a wax-ball dispatch to discuss attacking Han.

units.zh: 秋七月壬申，皇子賢生。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month, on renshen day, Prince Xian was born.
units.literal: On renshen day in the seventh autumn month Prince Xian was born.

units.zh: 冬十月壬午，南京留守魏王趙延壽薨，以中臺省右相牒哷葛為南京留守，封燕王。
units.en: On renwu day in the tenth winter month Zhao Yanshou, Prince Wei and regent of the Southern Capital, died; Dielige, right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, was made regent of the Southern Capital and enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.
units.literal: On renwu day in the tenth winter month Zhao Yanshou, Prince Wei and regent of the Southern Capital, died; Central Secretariat Right Chancellor Dielige was made regent of the Southern Capital and enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.

units.zh: 十一月，駐蹕彰武南。
units.en: In the eleventh month he halted the imperial progress south of Zhangwu.
units.literal: In the eleventh month he halted the imperial progress south of Zhangwu.

units.zh: 三年春正月，蕭翰及公主阿不裏謀反，翰伏誅，阿不裏瘐死獄中。
units.en: In the spring of the third year, first month, Xiao Han and Princess Abuli plotted rebellion; Han was executed, and Abuli wasted away and died in prison.
units.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, Xiao Han and Princess Abuli plotted rebellion; Han was executed, and Abuli died of illness in prison.

units.zh: 庚申，肆赦。
units.en: On gengshen day he proclaimed a general amnesty.
units.literal: On gengshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 內外官各進一階。
units.en: Every civil and military official was promoted one step in rank.
units.literal: Civil and military officials alike were promoted one rank.

units.zh: 夏六月戊寅，以敞史耶律胡離軫為北院大王。
units.en: That summer, on wuyin day of the sixth month, Yelü Hulizhen, chamberlain of records, was made Northern Chancellor.
units.literal: That summer, on wuyin day of the sixth month, Yelü Hulizhen, chamberlain of records, was made Northern Chancellor.

units.zh: 己卯，惕隱頹昱封漆水郡王。
units.en: On jimao day tiyin Tuibai was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui commandery.
units.literal: On jimao day tiyin Tuibai was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui commandery.

units.zh: 秋九月辛丑朔，召群臣議南伐。
units.en: On the xinchou new moon of the ninth autumn month he summoned the ministers to deliberate on a southern campaign.
units.literal: On the xinchou new moon of the ninth autumn month the ministers were summoned to discuss a southern campaign.

units.zh: 冬十月，遣諸將率兵攻下貝州高老鎮，徇地鄴都、南宮、堂陽，殺深州刺史史萬山，俘獲甚眾。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter he sent generals with troops to take Gaolao town in Bei Prefecture, raided through Yedu, Nangong, and Tangyang, killed Shen Prefecture prefect Shi Wanshan, and captured a great host.
units.literal: In the tenth winter month generals were dispatched with troops to capture Gaolao town in Bei Prefecture, marched through Yedu, Nangong, and Tangyang, killed Shen Prefecture prefect Shi Wanshan, and took many captives.

units.zh: 四年春二月辛未，泰寧王察割來朝，留侍。
units.en: In the fourth year, spring, second month, on xinwei day Prince of Taining Chage came to court and was kept in attendance at court.
units.literal: In the fourth year, spring, second month, on xinwei day Prince of Taining Chage came to court and was kept in attendance.

units.zh: 是月，建政事省。
units.en: That month he established the Directorate of Government Affairs.
units.literal: That month the Directorate of Government Affairs was established.

units.zh: 三月戊戌朔，南唐遣趙延嗣、張福等來賀南征捷。
units.en: On the wuxu new moon of the third month Southern Tang sent Zhao Yansi, Zhang Fu, and others to congratulate him on the southern campaign's victory.
units.literal: On the wuxu new moon of the third month Southern Tang sent Zhao Yansi, Zhang Fu, and others to congratulate him on the southern campaign's victory.

units.zh: 秋九月乙丑朔，如山西。
units.en: On the yichou new moon of the ninth autumn month he traveled to Shanxi.
units.literal: On the yichou new moon of the ninth autumn month he went to Shanxi.

units.zh: 冬十月，自將南伐，攻下安平、內丘、束鹿等城，大獲而還。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter he personally led a southern campaign, took Anping, Neiqiu, Shulu, and other cities, and returned laden with booty.
units.literal: In the tenth winter month he personally led a southern campaign, captured Anping, Neiqiu, Shulu, and other cities, and returned with great spoils.

units.zh: 是歲，冊皇后蕭氏。
units.en: That year he installed Lady Xiao as empress.
units.literal: That year Lady Xiao was installed as empress.

units.zh: 五年春正月癸亥朔，如百泉湖。
units.en: On the guihai new moon of the first spring month of the fifth year he went to Baiquan Lake.
units.literal: On the guihai new moon of the first spring month of the fifth year he went to Baiquan Lake.

units.zh: 漢郭威弒其主自立，國號周，遣朱憲來告。
units.en: Guo Wei of Han murdered his sovereign and declared himself emperor under the state name Zhou, then sent Zhu Xian to announce it.
units.literal: Guo Wei of Han murdered his lord and declared himself emperor; his state name was Zhou, and he sent Zhu Xian to report it.

units.zh: 即遣使致良馬。
units.en: He at once sent envoys presenting fine horses.
units.literal: At once envoys were dispatched presenting fine horses.

units.zh: 漢劉崇自立於太原。
units.en: Liu Chong of Han declared himself emperor at Taiyuan.
units.literal: Liu Chong of Han declared himself emperor at Taiyuan.

units.zh: 二月，周遣姚漢英、華昭胤來，以書辭抗禮，留漢英等。
units.en: In the second month Zhou sent Yao Hanying and Hua Zhaoyin; because their letter used language asserting equal standing, Hanying and the others were detained.
units.literal: In the second month Zhou sent Yao Hanying and Hua Zhaoyin; because their letter used language of equal standing, Hanying and the others were detained.

units.zh: 夏五月壬戌朔，太子太傅趙瑩薨，輟朝一日，命歸葬於汴。
units.en: On the renxu new moon of the fifth summer month Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhao Ying died; court was suspended for one day, and he was ordered interred at Bian.
units.literal: On the renxu new moon of the fifth summer month Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhao Ying died; court was suspended for one day, and he was ordered buried at Bian.

units.zh: 詔州縣錄事參軍、主簿委政事省銓註。
units.en: An edict entrusted the appointment of prefectural and county recorders and registrars to the Directorate of Government Affairs.
units.literal: An edict entrusted the appointment of prefectural and county recorders and registrars to the Directorate of Government Affairs.

units.zh: 六月辛卯朔，劉崇為周所攻，遣使稱，乞援，且求封冊。
units.en: On the xinmao new moon of the sixth month Liu Chong was attacked by Zhou; he sent envoys declaring submission, begging aid, and requesting formal investiture.
units.literal: On the xinmao new moon of the sixth month Liu Chong was attacked by Zhou; he sent envoys declaring submission, begging aid, and also requesting investiture.

units.zh: 即遣燕王牒哷、樞密使高勛冊為大漢神武皇帝。
units.en: He at once sent Prince of Yan Dielie and Palace Secretariat Commissioner Gao Xun to invest him as Emperor Shenwu of Great Han.
units.literal: At once Prince of Yan Dielie and Palace Secretariat Commissioner Gao Xun were dispatched to invest him as Emperor Shenwu of Great Han.

units.zh: 南唐遣蔣洪來，乞舉兵應援。
units.en: Southern Tang sent Jiang Hong, begging that troops be raised in support.
units.literal: Southern Tang sent Jiang Hong, begging that troops be raised in support.

units.zh: 是夏，清暑百泉嶺。
units.en: That summer he escaped the heat at Baiquan Ridge.
units.literal: That summer he escaped the heat at Baiquan Ridge.

units.zh: 九月庚申朔，自將南伐。
units.en: On the gengshen new moon of the ninth month he personally led a southern campaign.
units.literal: On the gengshen new moon of the ninth month he personally led a southern campaign.

units.zh: 壬戌，次歸化州祥古山。
units.en: On renxu day he halted at Xianggu Mountain in Guihua Prefecture.
units.literal: On renxu day he halted at Xianggu Mountain in Guihua Prefecture.

units.zh: 癸亥，祭讓國皇帝於行宮。
units.en: On guihai day he sacrificed to the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm at the traveling palace.
units.literal: On guihai day he sacrificed to the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm at the traveling palace.

units.zh: 群臣皆醉，察割反，帝遇弒，年三十四。
units.en: All the ministers were drunk; Chage rebelled, and the emperor was assassinated at the age of thirty-four.
units.literal: All the ministers were drunk; Chage rebelled, and the emperor was assassinated, aged thirty-four.

units.zh: 應歷元年，葬於顯州西山，陵曰顯陵。
units.en: In the first year of Yingli he was buried on the western hills of Xian Prefecture; the mausoleum was called Xian Mausoleum.
units.literal: In the first year of Yingli he was buried on the western hills of Xian Prefecture; the mausoleum was called Xian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 二年，謚孝和皇帝，廟號世宗。
units.en: In the second year he was posthumously titled Emperor Xiaohé, with the temple name Shizong.
units.literal: In the second year he was posthumously titled Emperor Xiaohé, with temple name Shizong.

units.zh: 統和二十六年七月，加謚孝和莊憲皇帝。
units.en: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe his posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Xiaohé Zhuangxian.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe his posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Xiaohé Zhuangxian.

units.zh: 贊曰：世宗中才之主也，入繼大統，曾未三年，納唐丸書，即議南伐，即乏持重，宜乖周防，蓋有致禍之道矣。
units.en: The eulogy says: Shizong was a ruler of middling talent. Having succeeded to the great mandate, within barely three years he accepted Tang's wax-sealed letter and at once debated a southern campaign — lacking steadiness and contrary to circumspection; he surely had within him the ways that bring ruin.
units.literal: The eulogy says: Shizong was a ruler of middling talent. Having succeeded to the great mandate, within barely three years he accepted Tang's wax-sealed letter and at once debated a southern campaign — lacking steadiness, contrary to circumspection; he surely had the ways that bring ruin.

units.zh: 然而孝友寬慈，亦有君人之度焉。
units.en: Yet in filial piety, brotherly affection, lenience, and kindness he still showed a measure fit for a ruler.
units.literal: Yet he was filial, friendly, lenient, and kind, and possessed something of a ruler's measure.

units.zh: 未及師還，變起沈湎，豈不可哀也哉！
units.en: Before the army could return, upheaval arose from deep drinking — how could it not be lamentable!
units.literal: Before the army could return, upheaval arose from deep drinking — how could it not be lamentable!

units.zh: 乙巳，蕭思溫封魏王，北院大王屋質加於越。
units.en: On yisi day Xiao Siwen was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, and Northern Grand Prince Wuzhi was promoted to yuyue.
units.literal: On yisi day Xiao Siwen was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, and Northern Grand Prince Wuzhi was advanced to yuyue.

units.zh: 五月癸亥，於越屋質薨，輟朝三日。
units.en: In the fifth month, on guihai day, yuyue Wuzhi died; court was suspended for three days.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on guihai day, yuyue Wuzhi died; court was suspended for three days.

units.zh: 隱帝，高祖第二子承祐也。
units.en: Yindi was Gaozu’s second son, Chengyou.
units.literal: Yindi was Gaozu’s second son, Chengyou.

units.zh: 二年隱帝即位至此，宜改元而不改元，具周顯德二年注。
units.en: From Yindi’s accession in year 2 down to here, the reign title should have been changed but was not; the full note appears under Zhou Xiande 2.
units.literal: From Yindi’s accession in year 2 to this point, the reign title ought to have been changed but was not; this is fully noted under Zhou Xiande 2.

units.zh: 自隱帝崩後四十二日，周太祖始即位，而斷自帝崩書「漢亡」者，見帝而漢崩亡矣。
units.en: Taizu of Zhou did not take the throne until forty-two days after Yindi died, but the text marks “Han perished” at the emperor’s death to show that Han fell with him.
units.literal: Forty-two days after Yindi died, Taizu of Zhou finally took the throne; yet cutting it off at the emperor’s death and writing “Han perished” shows that with the emperor Han had collapsed and perished.

units.zh: 高祖即位，拜右衞上將軍、大內都點檢。
units.en: After Gaozu took the throne, Chengyou was appointed Senior General of the Right Guard and inspector-general of the inner palace.
units.literal: When Gaozu took the throne, Chengyou was appointed Senior General of the Right Guard and Inspector-general of the Inner Palace.

units.zh: 高祖愛之，方屬以為嗣，承訓薨，高祖不豫，悲哀疾劇，乃以承祐屬諸將相。
units.en: Gaozu loved him and intended to make him heir, but Chengxun died. Gaozu fell ill, grief worsened the sickness, and he entrusted Chengyou to the generals and ministers.
units.literal: Gaozu loved him and was just about to entrust the succession to him when Chengxun died. Gaozu fell ill, and his grief made the illness severe; he then entrusted Chengyou to the generals and ministers.

units.zh: 宰相蘇逢吉曰：「皇子承祐未封王，請亟封之。」
units.en: Chancellor Su Fengji said, “The imperial son Chengyou has not yet been made a prince. Please enfeoff him immediately.”
units.literal: The chancellor Su Fengji said, “The imperial son Chengyou has not yet been enfeoffed as prince; please enfeoff him at once.”

units.zh: 乾祐元年二月辛巳，封承祐周王。
units.en: On xinsi in the second month of Qianyou 1 Chengyou was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhou.
units.literal: On xinsi of the second month of Qianyou 1, Chengyou was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou.

units.zh: 而帝名承祐，年名乾祐，舉國臣民共稱而不改避，當時莫大之失，本紀無譏者，但書其實，後世自見也。
units.en: The emperor’s personal name was Chengyou, while the reign title was Qianyou; the entire realm used it without alteration or avoidance, an enormous fault at the time. The Basic Annals do not comment, but by recording the facts let later readers see it.
units.literal: Moreover, the emperor’s name was Chengyou and the reign name was Qianyou; the whole state, ministers and people alike, used it without changing or avoiding it, which was the greatest error of the time. The Basic Annals do not criticize it, but only write the facts, so later generations will see it for themselves.

units.zh: 是日，皇帝即位於柩前。
units.en: That same day the Hidden Emperor took the throne before the bier.
units.literal: That day the emperor ascended the throne before the coffin.

units.zh: 乙酉，皇帝崩，年二十。
units.en: On yiyou the emperor died at the age of twenty.
units.literal: On yiyou, the emperor died; he was twenty years old.

units.zh: 周廣順元年葬之許州陽翟縣，號潁陵，為賊所葬，故不書。
units.en: In Zhou Guangshun 1 he was buried at Yangzhai county in Xuzhou and the tomb was called Yingling. Because rebels buried him, the text does not record it.
units.literal: In Zhou Guangshun 1 he was buried in Yangzhai county, Xuzhou; it was named Yingling, but because he was buried by rebels, it is not written.

units.zh: 逆臣察割等伏誅。
units.en: The rebel Chage and his accomplices were put to death.
units.literal: The treacherous ministers Chage and others were executed.

units.zh: 戊午，詔以先平察割日，用白黑羊、玄酒祭天，歲以為常。
units.en: On wuwu day an edict established an annual rite: on the anniversary of Chage's defeat, heaven was to be sacrificed to with white and black sheep and dark wine.
units.literal: On wuwu day an edict ordered that on the anniversary of Chage's defeat, white and black sheep and dark wine be used to sacrifice to heaven — established as an annual rite.

units.zh: 世宗天祿二年，天德、蕭翰、劉哥及其弟盆都等謀反，天德伏誅，杖翰，流劉哥，遣盆都使轄戛斯國。
units.en: In Shizong's second year of Tianlu, Tiande, Xiao Han, Liuge, and Liuge's brother Pendu plotted rebellion. Tiande was executed, Han beaten, Liuge exiled, and Pendu dispatched as envoy to the Kirghiz.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianlu under Shizong, Tiande, Xiao Han, Liuge, and Liuge's younger brother Pendu and others plotted rebellion. Tiande was executed, Han was beaten, Liuge was exiled, and Pendu was sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.

units.zh: 庚戌，帝以北京馬步軍都指揮使、泗州防禦使、檢校太保劉崇為太原尹、檢校太尉，以北京馬步軍都虞候郭從義為鄭州防禦使、檢校太保，以北京興捷左廂都指揮使李洪信為陳州刺史、檢校司徒，以興捷右廂都指揮使尚洪遷為單州刺史、檢校司徒，以北京武節左廂都指揮使蓋萬為蔡州刺史，以武節右廂都指揮使周暉為濮州刺史，以保寧都指揮使朱奉千為隨州刺史。
units.en: On gengxu the emperor appointed Liu Chong prefect of Taiyuan, Guo Congyi defender of Zhengzhou, Li Hongxin prefect of Chenzhou, Shang Hongqian prefect of Shanzhou, Gai Wan prefect of Caizhou, Zhou Hui prefect of Puzhou, and Zhu Fengqian prefect of Suizhou, with the appropriate acting ranks.
units.literal: On the day gengxu the Emperor appointed Liu Chong, Commander-in-Chief of the Northern Capital's cavalry and infantry, Defender of Sizhou and Acting Grand Guardian, Yin of Taiyuan and Acting Grand Marshal; Guo Congyi, chief registrar of the Northern Capital's horse and foot, Defender of Zhengzhou and Acting Grand Guardian; Li Hongxin, commander of the left wing of the Northern Capital's Xingjie army, Prefect of Chenzhou and Acting Minister of Works; Shang Hongqian, commander of the right wing of the Xingjie army, Prefect of Shanzhou and Acting Minister of Works; Gai Wan, commander of the left wing of the Wujie army, Prefect of Caizhou; Zhou Hui, commander of the right wing of the Wujie army, Prefect of Puzhou; and Zhu Fengqian, commander of the Baoning army, Prefect of Suizhou.

units.zh: 會契丹主死，其汴州節度使蕭翰謀歸北地，慮中原無主，軍民大亂，則己亦不得按轡徐歸矣；
units.en: When the Khitan ruler died, his Bianzhou military commissioner Xiao Han planned to return north. He feared that with no ruler in the Central Plains and army and people in chaos, he himself could not withdraw at leisure;
units.literal: When the Khitan ruler died, his Bianzhou military commissioner Xiao Han planned to return north and feared that with no ruler in central China and army and people in great disorder, he himself would be unable to rein in his horse and withdraw at leisure;

units.zh: 蕭翰率蕃首列拜於殿上，群官趨於殿下，乃偽署王鬆為左丞相，趙上交為右丞相。
units.en: Xiao Han led the Khitan chiefs in ranks bowing in the hall while the officials hurried to below the steps. He falsely appointed Wang Song Left Chancellor and Zhao Shangjiao Right Chancellor.
units.literal: Xiao Han led the Khitan chiefs in ranks bowing in the hall; the officials hurried to below the steps, and he falsely appointed Wang Song as Left Chancellor and Zhao Shangjiao as Right Chancellor.

units.zh: 翰北歸，從益餞於北郊。
units.en: When Xiao Han marched north, Congyi gave him a farewell feast at the Northern Suburb.
units.literal: When Han returned north, Congyi gave a farewell feast at the Northern Suburb.

units.zh: 乃詐稱契丹主命，遣人迎從益於洛陽，令知南朝軍國事。
units.en: so he falsely claimed the Khitan ruler's command, sent men to summon Congyi from Luoyang, and installed him to govern the southern court's military and civil affairs.
units.literal: therefore he falsely claimed the Khitan ruler's command, sent men to welcome Congyi from Luoyang, and ordered him to manage the military and civil affairs of the southern court.

units.zh: 詔河東將佐節度判官趙瑩以下十四人並籍沒家產。
units.en: An edict ordered that Zhao Ying, military administrator of Hedong circuit, and fourteen of his subordinates below him all have their household property registered and confiscated.
units.literal: An edict ordered that Zhao Ying, military administrator of Hedong circuit, and fourteen subordinates below him all have their household property registered and confiscated.

units.zh: 以汝州防禦使趙延壽為河陽節度使，以比部郎中、知制誥劉讚為中書舍人，以河陽掌書記程遜為比部員外郎、知制誥，以代州刺史李德充為蔚州刺史。
units.en: Zhao Yanshou, Ru defense commissioner, became Heyang commissioner; Liu Zan, Bureau of Revenue director and edict drafter, became Secretariat drafting officer; Cheng Xun, Heyang secretary, became Bureau of Revenue vice director and edict drafter; Li Dechong of Dai became Yu prefect.
units.literal: Ruzhou defense commissioner Zhao Yanshou was made Heyang military commissioner; Bureau of Revenue director and edict drafter Liu Zan was made Secretariat drafting officer; Heyang secretary Cheng Xun was made Bureau of Revenue vice director and edict drafter; Dai prefect Li Dechong was made Yu prefect.

units.zh: 青州奏，得登州狀，契丹阿保機男東丹王突欲越海來歸國。
units.en: Qing reported notice from Deng: Khitan Abaoji's son, Eastern Dan prince Yelü Bei, crossed the sea to return to the dynasty.
units.literal: Qingzhou reported receiving notice from Deng prefecture: Khitan Abaoji's son, Eastern Dan prince Yelü Bei, crossed the sea to return to the dynasty.

units.zh: 〈（《契丹國志》：時東丹王失職怨望，因率其部四十餘人越海歸唐。）〉
units.en: (The 《Khitan State Annals》 says the Eastern Dan prince, displaced and resentful, led more than forty followers across the sea to Tang.)〉
units.literal: (The 《Khitan State Annals》: At the time the Eastern Dan prince, displaced and resentful, led more than forty of his followers across the sea to return to Tang.)〉

units.zh: 耶律學古，字乙辛隱，於越窪之庶孫。
units.en: Yelu Xuegu, whose courtesy name was Yixinyin, was a grandson by a concubine of the Yuyue Wa.
units.literal: Yelu Xuegu, courtesy name Yixin, was a grandson by a concubine of the Yuyue Wa.

units.zh: 保寧中，補禦盞郎君。
units.en: During Baoning he was appointed cupbearer of the imperial guard.
units.literal: In Baoning he was appointed Cupbearer of the Imperial Guard.

units.zh: 後隨契丹至常山，其將解裏遣殷與契丹首領楊安，同拒我師於洺水，俄而安退，殷以橐裝駝馬遺安。
units.en: He later followed the Khitan to Changshan. The Khitan general Jieli sent Yin with the Khitan leader Yang An to block our army at the Ming River. When Yang An soon withdrew, Yin gave him pack camels loaded with goods.
units.literal: Later he followed the Khitan to Changshan; their general Jieli sent Yin together with the Khitan leader Yang An to jointly resist our army at the Ming River. Soon An withdrew; Yin gave An pack animals and camels loaded with goods.

units.zh: 重熙二十年，增謚文獻欽義皇帝，廟號義宗，及謚二后曰端順，曰柔貞。
units.en: In Chongxi year 20 his honorific was advanced to Emperor Wenxian, Qinyi; his temple name was Yizong, and his two consorts were posthumously styled Duanshun and Rouzhen.
units.literal: In the twentieth year of Chongxi his honorific was advanced to Emperor Wenxian, Qinyi; his temple name was Yizong, and the two empresses were posthumously titled Duanshun and Rouzhen.

units.zh: 丙辰，以秘書監呂琦為禮部侍郎，歸德軍節度使趙在禮改天平軍節度使，昭義軍節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都虞候杜重威改忠武軍節度使，忠武軍節度使、侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使劉知遠改歸德軍節度使，前河陽節度使兼奉國左右廂都指揮使侯益改昭義軍節度使。
units.en: On bingchen Lü Qi, palace library director, became vice minister of rites; Zhao Zaili of Guide became Tianping military commissioner; Du Chongwei of Zhaoyi became Zhongwu military commissioner; Liu Zhiyuan of Zhongwu became Guide military commissioner; and Hou Yi, former Heyang commissioner, became Zhaoyi military commissioner.
units.literal: On bingchen, Lü Qi, Director of the Palace Library, was appointed Vice Minister of Rites; Zhao Zaili, Military Commissioner of the Guide Army, was changed to Military Commissioner of the Tianping Army; Du Chongwei, Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi and Chief Adjutant of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot, was changed to Military Commissioner of the Zhongwu Army; Liu Zhiyuan, Military Commissioner of the Zhongwu Army and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot, was changed to Military Commissioner of the Guide Army; Hou Yi, former Military Commissioner of Heyang and Commander of the Left and Right Wings of the Fengguo Army, was changed to Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi.

units.zh: 己巳，遣左金吾衛將軍姚漢英、前右神武將軍華光裔使於契丹。
units.en: On jisi day, Yao Hanying, General of the Left Golden Guard, and Hua Guangyi, former General of the Right Divine Martial Guard, were sent as envoys to the Khitan.
units.literal: On the day jisi, Yao Hanying, General of the Left Golden Guard, and Hua Guangyi, former General of the Right Divine Martial Guard, were dispatched as envoys to the Khitan.

units.zh: 皇子李胡生。
units.en: The prince Li Hu was born.
units.literal: The Prince Li Hu was born.

units.zh: 近侍劉哥、烏古斯嘗從齊王妻而逃，以赦，後會千齡節出首，乃詔諸近侍、護衛集視而腰斬之。
units.en: Attendants Liuge and Wugusi had once fled with the Prince of Qi's wife; though pardoned, they confessed at the Thousand-Age Festival; the emperor then had all attendants and guards assembled to witness their execution by cutting in two at the waist.
units.literal: Close attendants Liuge and Wugusi had once fled with the wife of the Prince of Qi; they were pardoned, but later at the Thousand-Age Festival they came forward to confess; he then ordered all close attendants and guards assembled to witness their execution by cutting at the waist.

units.zh: 漆水郡王頹昱。
units.en: Tuishu, Prince of Qishui Commandery.
units.literal: Prince of Qishui Commandery, Tuishu.

units.zh: 孟父房楚國王之後，不知世次：
units.en: Descendants of the Mengfu House King of Chu; generation unknown:
units.literal: Descendants of the Mengfu House King of Chu; generation unknown:

units.zh: 右係出玄祖簡獻皇帝。
units.en: Right descent line from Emperor Xuanzu the Simple and Offering.
units.literal: Right descent line from Emperor Xuanzu the Simple and Offering.

units.zh: 契丹主兀欲遣。
units.en: The Khitan ruler Wuyu sent
units.literal: The Khitan ruler Wuyu sent

units.zh: 丁巳，尚書左丞田敏使契丹回。
units.en: On dingsi day, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of State Affairs, returned from his embassy to the Khitan.
units.literal: On the day dingsi, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, returned from his mission to the Khitan.

units.zh: 使耨姑報命，並獻碧玉金塗銀裹鞍勒各一副，弓矢、器仗、貂裘等，土產馬三十匹、土產漢馬十匹。
units.en: the envoy Nuguga to report in reply, together with jade saddles with gold inlay and silver mountings, bows and arrows, arms and armor, sable furs, thirty native horses, and ten native Han horses.
units.literal: the envoy Nuguga to report in reply, and also presented one set each of jade-and-gold-inlaid silver-mounted saddles and bridles, bows and arrows, weapons and armor, sable furs, and the like, thirty native horses and ten native Han horses.

units.zh: 以上將既變，乃俯首聽命，遂連署降表，令中門使高勛賫送敵帳，軍士解甲，舉聲慟哭。
units.en: With the commander already set on treason, they could only bow and obey. A joint surrender memorial was drawn up and sent to the enemy camp by Inner Gate Commissioner Gao Xun. The troops laid down their arms and wept aloud.
units.literal: Because the supreme commander had already changed his mind, they bowed their heads and obeyed. They then jointly signed a surrender memorial, had Inner Gate Commissioner Gao Xun carry it to the enemy camp, and the soldiers doffed their armor and broke into wailing cries.

units.zh: 以蕃漢兵馬都孔目官郭威為權樞密使、檢校司徒；
units.en: Guo Wei was made acting Commissioner of Military Affairs and Acting Minister of Works;
units.literal: Guo Wei, chief clerk of tribal and Han forces, was made acting Commissioner of Military Affairs and Acting Minister of Works;

names: en:king of yan killed by gongsun cao in 271
King of Yan (killed by Gongsun Cao in 271)
